name: Monolith Reveal
description: Scrolling list of large parallax image previews with titles. Clicking one flips the image into a detail page with title, meta, line-revealed text and thumbnails, then flips back on return.
contents: Sticky side frame with a vertical label and note
Full-width image previews with title, subtitle and description
Detail view per item with title, meta, text and four thumbnails
behavior: Preview image zooms and title shifts with scroll scrub
Click flips the image into the detail view while other previews slide away
Detail text is split into lines that reveal on open
Page scroll is locked while a detail view is open
Text lines are re-split on window resize; sidebar frame becomes a top bar on mobile
editableByProps: All items, images, titles, texts, meta and thumbnails
Colors, fonts, labels, animation duration, easing and zoom
Smooth scroll on or off and the side frame on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how many thumbnails or the detail layout
needsCodeEdit.where: content__thumbs grid inside the items.map in the content-wrap section
loader-dot block rendered while ready is false

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Adds a locked class to document body while a detail view is open and removes it on close and unmount
Full-screen loader overlay shows until images are preloaded
Detail view is sticky and fills the viewport height
